name: init-plan
description: Plan-document harness: bootstrap canonical plan/ documents, author the SDD/API/SDS/SCS suite, and retrieve source-backed plan evidence via Plan RAG.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, design, and retrieve project plan documents.
interface.longDescription: Three skills plus a Plan RAG MCP server. init-plan writes a project's canonical plan/ documents from a spec; software-doc-suite routes content into SDD, API Docs, SDS, and SCS; plan-rag searches and safely updates the plan corpus with source-backed excerpts.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the plan/ documents for this project.
Restructure these docs into an SDD and API reference.
What does the plan say about phase 2?
